lesson.title: Share a decimal equally
lesson.subtitle: P4 decimal revision
lesson.objective: Multiply or divide a decimal by a one-digit whole number.
lesson.story: Calculate with equal place units and check the result.

steps.title: Choose equal units

choices.label: Line up the last written digits even when their places differ.
Let the groups have different sizes as long as they add up.
Use the whole number as the number of equal groups.

hints: Start with the number of groups.
Each group contains the same amount.
Multiplying or dividing by a whole number uses equal groups.
Choose the explanation that uses the stated number of equal groups.

steps.title: Calculate with decimals
hints: Look at the units before calculating.
Use the stated number of equal groups.
Use matching place units to work out 5.4 ÷ 6.

steps.title: Check by reversing
hints: Reverse the operation to check the original value.
Multiplication and division undo each other.
Use the same whole-number factor or divisor.
The check gives 5.4, the original value.

steps.title: Explain the equal units
steps.prompt: What helps us calculate with decimals?

choices.label: Use equal place units and check the relationship.
A decimal point means we can ignore zero places.
The number of written digits always tells us the value.

hints: Tenths and hundredths are different-sized units.
A relationship only works when we use the matching units.
Choose: Use equal place units and check the relationship.
